title: Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 Announced for English Release!
text: The English edition of Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 is set to go on sale in North America on October 20, 2026, published by Airship. The 224-page light novel features story and art by Hitoma Iruma, raemz, and Non. Titled "Putting on a Show," the volume follows Adachi and Shimamura as third-year students who somehow completely forgot about the Culture Festival until they were invited to participate. Although the event will only last a couple of days, it seems Adachi has something a little extra in mind.

title: Volume SS3 Announced!
text: Adachi to Shimamura's third short story collection goes on sale in Japan on September 10. Alongside "Her Memories," which follows a trip the two take as university students, this volume includes many newly written stories about their everyday life at home, at the supermarket, and even overseas.

title: SS3 Bonus Items Revealed at Melonbooks and Gamers!
text: Melonbooks and Gamers have now revealed their respective purchase bonus items for Adachi to Shimamura Volume SS3. The third short story collection is scheduled to go on sale in Japan on September 10, with both stores offering special bonuses for customers who purchase the volume.
